pattern_description: Multi-card syndicate operating through shared device profile (Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 65.0 | 1920x1080) across 300 distinct cards and 299 customers, operating behind an anonymous proxy and linked to 1173 prior closed fraud cases.
sar_narrative:
SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT (SAR) NARRATIVE
Case Reference: HHG-017
Subject Customer: C04570 | Subject Card: C04570-K1
Activity Period: 2016-11-12 00:46:24 | Cumulative Exposure: $100.09
Primary Typology: UNDOCUMENTED

1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:
Financial institution automated graph surveillance identified organized anomalous activity involving customer C04570 and card C04570-K1, resulting in cumulative suspicious exposure of $100.09 across transaction(s) 3450629.

2. GRAPH & DEVICE TOPOLOGY ANALYSIS:
Graph traversal revealed that transaction 3450629 originated from device profile 'Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 65.0 | 1920x1080' (Device ID: DEV_8ea57628c8af). Graph topological queries confirmed this exact device profile is shared across 300 distinct cardholder accounts and is connected to 1173 previously confirmed fraud case(s) (CC-0249, CC-2519, CC-2865, CC-0248). Activity exhibited proxy masking characteristics (Proxy status: IP_PROXY:HIDDEN).

3. POLICY COMPLIANCE & ACTIONS TAKEN:
In accordance with Fraud Policy v1.0 (Rules R6, R8, R9), the institution initiated immediate defensive card blocks, escalated the case to Senior Fraud Management (Level 2 Approval), and filed this formal FinCEN SAR.

evidence.claim: Device profile (Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 65.0 | 1920x1080) is shared across 300 cards and 299 distinct customers, linked to 1173 historical fraud cases (CC-0249, CC-2519, CC-2865)

containment_steps: Immediate hard block on primary compromised card C04570-K1
Identify and freeze all companion cards sharing device profile across graph
Add device hardware fingerprint and proxy IP ranges to real-time blacklists
Revoke active web/mobile banking sessions for affected accounts

customer_communication.message_copy: Dear Cardholder, we detected unauthorized activity on your card ending in 0-K1. For your security, we have placed a hold on the card. A fraud specialist will contact you to reissue a new card.

financial_remediation: Issue provisional credit to affected cardholder(s)
Waive all associated late fees or overdraft charges
compliance_actions: File FinCEN Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) under Rule R9 (Organized Proxy Syndicate)
Escalate case dossier to Senior Fraud Operations & Legal Compliance (Level 2 Approval)
Write finalized investigation dossier and syndicate links back to TigerGraph
